question: 这份关于中国进口关税的公告改了什么？能结合贸易数据解释一下吗？

fields.value: Executive Order 14259—Amendment to Reciprocal Tariffs and Updated Duties as Applied to Low-Value Imports From the People's Republic of China
quotes: Executive Order 14259—Amendment to Reciprocal Tariffs and Updated Duties as Applied to Low-Value Imports From the People's Republic of China
The White House, April 8, 2025.
This Executive order was published in the Federal Register on April 14.

fields.value: 原文有多个日期：第2节税率修改自2025-04-09 00:01 EDT适用于消费入境或从保税仓提取供消费的货品；第3节按件税分为2025-05-02起至2025-06-01前、2025-06-01起两段。第3(a)款90%从价税的完整实施条件须结合被引用的EO14256，不把4月9日套到整份公告。
quotes: Effective with respect to goods entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on April 9, 2025:

increase the per postal item containing goods duty in section 2(c)(ii) of Executive Order 14256 that is in effect on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on May 2, 2025, and before 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on June 1, 2025, from 25 dollars to 75 dollars; and

increase the per postal item containing goods duty in section 2(c)(ii) of Executive Order 14256 that is in effect on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on June 1, 2025, from 50 dollars to 150 dollars.

fields.value: 第2节明确为消费入境，或从保税仓提取供消费；第3节援引EO14256的低值进口及邮政单件计税条款，不能据第2节一句话认定两个分支条件完全相同。
quotes: Effective with respect to goods entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on April 9, 2025:
increase the ad valorem rate of duty set forth in section 2(c)(i) of Executive Order 14256 from 30 percent to 90 percent;

fields.reason: 本令针对中国相关关税，但通过既有HTS第99章条目和EO14256界定货品；完整原产地、发货地及香港适用规则未在本份原文重述。现有单文档参考不将其补猜为仅中国大陆。
原文列的是第99章特殊税率申报条目9903.01.63及其注释修订，没有列出可直接查询月度商品贸易的普通HTS8清单；不得把99030163作为普通商品编码。

value: 第2节：HTS 9903.01.63及相应注释中的34%改为84%；这是该条目的修改，不是综合应缴税率。
第3(a)款：EO14256第2(c)(i)款从价税由30%改为90%。
第3(c)款：2025-06-01 00:01 EDT起，邮政货品每件税由50美元改为150美元。
以上均为这份2025年原文的修改内容；后续修订和现行适用状态未核对。
quotes: heading 9903.01.63 of the HTSUS shall be amended by deleting "34%" each place that it appears and by inserting "84%" in lieu thereof; and
increase the ad valorem rate of duty set forth in section 2(c)(i) of Executive Order 14256 from 30 percent to 90 percent;

increase the per postal item containing goods duty in section 2(c)(ii) of Executive Order 14256 that is in effect on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on May 2, 2025, and before 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on June 1, 2025, from 25 dollars to 75 dollars; and

increase the per postal item containing goods duty in section 2(c)(ii) of Executive Order 14256 that is in effect on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on June 1, 2025, from 50 dollars to 150 dollars.

fields.value: 两类修改须分开：第2节修改既有HTS第99章对等关税条目；第3节修改EO14256低值进口的从价税和邮政单件税。84%、90%和每件75/150美元不可相加成统一综合税率。

increase the ad valorem rate of duty set forth in section 2(c)(i) of Executive Order 14256 from 30 percent to 90 percent;

本参考只登记EO14259原文；它发布之后的修订链、暂停或失效情况未核验，不能从原文推出今天应适用的税率。

linkage.policy_scope_summary: 这份修订令同时修改第99章一般关税条目和低值邮政税费，两个分支的日期与条件不同。当前只登记此份原文，未补齐被引用条款的完整对象；不能把全中国商品金额或某个普通商品组当作整份公告的对象。
